commit.message: feat(dcp): add dope-context and task-orchestrator readonly adapters

invariants: dope-context hits are DERIVED unless fetching exact source is implemented later.
Task-orchestrator status is workflow-view only, not PM metadata truth.
Caller cannot provide backend route or workflow project ID unless registry-bound.
OUT OF SCOPE: No search_all in Phase 1.
OUT OF SCOPE: No dope-context indexing/sync/clear/autonomous controls.
OUT OF SCOPE: No task-orchestrator transition, PM write routes, workflow idea/epic mutation, promotion, or WebSocket command surfaces.
OUT OF SCOPE: No bridge routing.
OUT OF SCOPE: No generic search/fetch.
STOP IF: dope-context requires search_all to produce useful results.
STOP IF: task-orchestrator project mapping is unresolved.
STOP IF: Adapter needs to touch target service code.
STOP IF: Denied routes appear in implementation outside tests/docs.

pr.body:
Add project-scoped dope-context and task-orchestrator read adapters while denying indexing, search_all, sync, transitions, PM write routes, and bridge/proxy access.

Required PR sections: Objective, Scope, Evidence, Validation, Embedded audit, Risks and unknowns, Rollback, Proof bundle links

Add tests for denial of search_all, indexing/sync/clear, transitions, PM routes.
Add docs for capability fallback when backend unavailable.
